claims.text: You do not need to buy a bulb: the manual lists the license plate illuminator as a 12 V LED unit, not a replaceable bulb.
The tail lamp/trafficator and license plate illuminator use an LED lighting system. If it fails, the entire tail lamp/trafficator and license plate illuminator assembly should be replaced.
Contact a Royal Enfield Authorised Dealer/Service Centre to have it replaced.
